name: Basic Collateral Valuation 1 Details
definition: Basic valuation details of a collateral position.

ValuationHaircut.name: Valuation Haircut
ValuationHaircut.definition: Haircut percentage applied to the market value of underlying assets used as collateral as a risk control measure. The institution valuating the collateral calculates the value of underlying assets based on its market value less a certain percentage (the haircut).

HaircutSource.name: Haircut Source
HaircutSource.definition: Place where the valuation haircut was calculated.
